title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.03577v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual

translated_title: Sonar-MoE：用于内存高效混合专家训练的反向传播内专家更新
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型的大多数参数都属于其专家模块，而标准训练会将每个专家的梯度保留在GPU内存中，直到优化器步进为止。这种内存占用会随着专家数量和规模的增长而增长，因此随着MoE模型的扩展而不断上升。我们提出了Sonar-MoE，它在反向传播过程中更新每个专家张量并立即释放其梯度。该方法将“反向传播内优化器”从稠密模型扩展到批处理的MoE专家张量，使GPU永远不会持有超过一层的专家梯度。在使用两种专家内核后端以bf16精度微调OLMoE-1B-7B和Granite-3.1-3B-A800M时，Sonar-MoE将峰值内存降低了19%到22%。其更新与不使用专家梯度裁剪的标准训练在位级别完全一致，留出损失与所有基线的差距保持在0.003以内。与使用全局范数裁剪的标准训练相比，每步训练时间也缩短了17%到23%。更新整个批处理张量而非单个张量……
tldr: Sonar-MoE通过在反向传播过程中即时更新并释放专家梯度，将MoE训练的峰值内存降低19%–22%、每步速度提升17%–23%，同时保持与标准训练位级别一致的结果。
en_tdlr: Sonar-MoE updates and frees expert gradients during the backward pass, reducing MoE training peak memory by 19-22% and speeding up each step by 17-23% while remaining bitwise identical to standard training.
